title: A man falls from a hotel window on Telegraph Avenue

tellings.quote: >> Because when I look up three stories up there's an open window with a curtain blowing and they jumped.

plain: In the late 1970s, on Telegraph Avenue in Berkeley, California, the Hollywood writer Brent Friedman says he saw the aftermath of someone falling from a hotel window. He tells Michels that when he looked up, "three stories up there's an open window with a curtain blowing and they jumped." He tells it as something he witnessed himself.
